_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Reject changing SysID valve responses before adoption, even when discovery and independent-check midpoint rates agree. Active current probes require retained matching primary-fit stationarity evidence recomputed from acceleration, uncertainty and exact acquisition duration. The same guard covers final firmware push, live results, PID Apply, known-good snapshots, archive restore/trust and cross-scan comparisons. Historical accepted profiles remain recoverable and raw evidence stays retained.

Default533/Valinor530 focused checks passed, final47 each, delivery regressions218/221, standard helper/parser/worker scripts and both layout/smoke checks passed. All26 frozen MID primary fits replay exactly; Arduino delivery20242/20242 and9535/9535=100%, nativeNI no gaps/backtracks. Separate verified restoration reconciles the paused-PRESSX cleanup attempt.

This release changes host acceptance only. Firmware, controller gains, timing, actuator limits and calibration remain unchanged. Startup inflation must accommodate both very large cuffs near the10second fill goal and the stronger wrist response; startup deflation, physical pulse preservation, achieved quiet SmartConstMAP+5 and all-band SysID qualification remain under investigation. No experimental tuning is adopted.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
